value.rationale: The graphs form the canonical complete nonisomorphic pair with strongly regular parameters (16,6,2,2), and both level-two complexes have the same reduced Euler characteristic 39. Exact integral torsion Z/2 in degree four occurs in only one, while the other is torsion-free. This gives a motivated, precise integral forest-filtration invariant beyond the prior first-stage homotopy results; no universal theorem is claimed.
